## Specification

### Block: Testimonials

Social proof for a landing page: what real customers say, with their name, role and company. A marketing block: kit components (`Avatar`, `AnimatedNumber`, `Button`) plus Tailwind utilities.

#### Variants
```
quote-grid   eyebrow · h2 · 6 quotes in CSS columns (1/2/3), the first one featured
single       eyebrow h2 · large quote mark · one big quote · author + link · 3 rolling stats
marquee      h2 · lead · Pause button | one row of quotes sliding left forever; reduced motion: a scrollable row
```

#### Anatomy
```
<figure>                       rounded-2xl border p-5/p-6, gap 20–24px
  <blockquote><p>“…”</p></blockquote>
  <figcaption>                 <Avatar size="sm"><AvatarFallback>PN</AvatarFallback></Avatar> · name (500) · role, company (muted)
```
Single: the stats are a `<dl>`; each `<div class="flex flex-col-reverse">` holds `<dt>` (label, muted 13px) then `<dd>` with `<AnimatedNumber value suffix animateOnView />` at 34px, so the number reads first visually and the label first for screen readers.
Marquee: viewport `overflow-hidden` with an edge fade `mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 8%, black 92%, transparent)` → track `flex w-max` → two identical copies `flex gap-4 pr-4`, the second `aria-hidden`.

#### Visual rules
- Quote text 15px/1.625; the featured grid quote 17px/500 on `bg-card` with a 160° `series-1` 9% linear tint.
- Single quote: `font-display` 24 → 28 → 34px, 500, leading 1.3; quote mark 32×24 SVG in `text-border`.
- Marquee cards are 288px (320px from `sm`) wide, `bg-card`.
- Body and quotes are left-aligned; never `text-wrap: balance`.

#### Motion
- Entrance: one `.ui-stagger` group, added when the block is 10% in view (`motion-safe:opacity-0` until then).
- Marquee: Web Animations API, `translateX(0 → -50%)` on the track, linear, infinite, 36px/s (duration = half the track width ÷ 36). Pointer hover pauses it; the Pause/Play button toggles it and stays until pressed again.
- Single: stats roll from 0 the first time they are half in view (`AnimatedNumber animateOnView`).
- Reduced motion (`matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')`, followed live): no marquee animation, no duplicate copy, no Pause button; the cards become a `snap-x` row that scrolls by hand, in a focusable `role="region" aria-label="Testimonials"`.

#### Accessibility
- Moving content has a visible pause control (WCAG 2.2.2) and stops on hover.
- The duplicated marquee copy is `aria-hidden` and contains nothing focusable.
- `figure` / `blockquote` / `figcaption` give quotes and attribution their meaning; avatars are initials only.

#### Responsive
- 360px: one column; the marquee header wraps the Pause button under the heading; the scroll row in reduced motion has 20px scroll padding.
- No horizontal page overflow: the marquee is clipped by its viewport.

#### Acceptance checks
- Marquee loops without a visible jump; it pauses on hover and with the button.
- With reduced motion it does not move and every quote is reachable by scrolling or keyboard.
- No horizontal overflow at 360px; axe reports no serious violations.

'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/ui/components/avatar';

const QUOTES = [
  {
    quote:
      'We went from two releases a week to forty a day, and our change failure rate went down. Halcyon made the safe path the easy path, so nobody argues with it.',
    name: 'Priya Natarajan',
    role: 'VP Engineering',
    company: 'Parallax',
    featured: true,
  },
  {
    quote: 'The first tool our on-call engineers asked us to keep after the trial ended.',
    name: 'Daniel Okafor',
    role: 'SRE lead',
    company: 'Quanta',
  },
  {
    quote:
      'Rollbacks used to be a war room. Now a bot posts “rolled back v4.12.1 in 41s” in Slack and we fix it in the morning.',
    name: 'Lena Fischer',
    role: 'Staff engineer',
    company: 'Foundry',
  },
  {
    quote: 'Our auditors asked how we produced the change log so quickly. We exported it from Halcyon in one click.',
    name: 'Marcus Chen',
    role: 'Head of Security',
    company: 'Meridian',
  },
  {
    quote:
      'Feature flags, deploys and incidents finally share one timeline. When something breaks, the cause is usually the first thing on screen.',
    name: 'Sofia Alvarez',
    role: 'Engineering manager',
    company: 'Copperleaf',
  },
  {
    quote: 'Setup took an afternoon. Pages at night dropped by 62% in the first month.',
    name: 'Tom Becker',
    role: 'CTO',
    company: 'Northbeam',
  },
];

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(' ')
    .map((p) => p[0])
    .join('')
    .slice(0, 2);

function useReveal<T extends HTMLElement>() {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {
      setShown(true);
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        if (entries.some((e) => e.isIntersecting)) {
          setShown(true);
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: '0px 0px -10% 0px' },
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return [ref, shown] as const;
}

export default function TestimonialsQuoteGrid() {
  const [gridRef, shown] = useReveal<HTMLUListElement>();

  return (
    <section className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background px-5 py-14 sm:px-8 sm:py-20">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl">
        <div className="max-w-2xl">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-primary-text">Customers</p>
          <h2 className="mt-3 font-display text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight sm:text-5xl">Loved by the people who carry the pager.</h2>
        </div>

        <ul
          ref={gridRef}
          className={`mt-12 columns-1 gap-4 sm:mt-14 md:columns-2 lg:columns-3 ${shown ? 'ui-stagger' : 'motion-safe:opacity-0'}`}
        >
          {QUOTES.map((q) => (
            <li key={q.name} className="mb-4 break-inside-avoid">
              <figure
                className={`flex flex-col gap-6 rounded-2xl border border-border p-6 ${q.featured ? 'bg-card' : 'bg-background'}`}
                style={
                  q.featured
                    ? { backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(160deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-series-1) 9%, transparent), transparent 60%)' }
                    : undefined
                }
              >
                <blockquote className={q.featured ? 'text-lg leading-relaxed font-medium' : 'text-md leading-relaxed'}>
                  <p>“{q.quote}”</p>
                </blockquote>
                <figcaption className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <Avatar size="sm">
                    <AvatarFallback>{initials(q.name)}</AvatarFallback>
                  </Avatar>
                  <div className="min-w-0 text-sm">
                    <p className="font-medium">{q.name}</p>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                      {q.role}, {q.company}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </figcaption>
              </figure>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

### Marquee row

File: `components/blocks/testimonials/marquee.tsx` (docs source: `apps/docs/examples/blocks/testimonials/marquee.tsx`)

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/ui/components/avatar';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';

const QUOTES = [
  { quote: 'Rollbacks went from a war room to a Slack message.', name: 'Lena Fischer', role: 'Staff engineer, Foundry' },
  { quote: 'The first tool our on-call team begged us to keep after the trial.', name: 'Daniel Okafor', role: 'SRE lead, Quanta' },
  { quote: 'We ship on Fridays again. Nobody has noticed, which is the point.', name: 'Priya Natarajan', role: 'VP Engineering, Parallax' },
  { quote: 'Audit prep used to take two weeks. Now it is one export.', name: 'Marcus Chen', role: 'Head of Security, Meridian' },
  { quote: 'Night pages dropped 62% in the first month.', name: 'Tom Becker', role: 'CTO, Northbeam' },
  { quote: 'Flags, deploys and incidents on one timeline. The cause is usually right there.', name: 'Sofia Alvarez', role: 'Engineering manager, Copperleaf' },
  { quote: 'Set up in an afternoon, trusted by the end of the week.', name: 'Yusuf Kaya', role: 'Platform lead, Lattice' },
  { quote: 'Our change failure rate halved while deploys tripled.', name: 'Hannah Moore', role: 'Director of Engineering, Brightwave' },
];

/** Scroll speed of the row, in px per second. */
const SPEED = 36;

const initials = (name: string) =>
  name
    .split(' ')
    .map((p) => p[0])
    .join('')
    .slice(0, 2);

function useReveal<T extends HTMLElement>() {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') {
      setShown(true);
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        if (entries.some((e) => e.isIntersecting)) {
          setShown(true);
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      },
      { rootMargin: '0px 0px -10% 0px' },
    );
    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return [ref, shown] as const;
}

/** True when the visitor asked for reduced motion; follows changes live. */
function useReducedMotion() {
  const [reduced, setReduced] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    const update = () => setReduced(mq.matches);
    update();
    mq.addEventListener('change', update);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener('change', update);
  }, []);
  return reduced;
}

function QuoteCard({ quote, name, role }: (typeof QUOTES)[number]) {
  return (
    <figure className="flex w-72 shrink-0 snap-start flex-col justify-between gap-5 rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card p-5 sm:w-80">
      <blockquote className="text-md leading-relaxed">
        <p>“{quote}”</p>
      </blockquote>
      <figcaption className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <Avatar size="sm">
          <AvatarFallback>{initials(name)}</AvatarFallback>
        </Avatar>
        <div className="min-w-0 text-sm">
          <p className="truncate font-medium">{name}</p>
          <p className="truncate text-muted-foreground">{role}</p>
        </div>
      </figcaption>
    </figure>
  );
}

export default function TestimonialsMarquee() {
  const [revealRef, shown] = useReveal<HTMLDivElement>();
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const trackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const animation = useRef<Animation | null>(null);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(false);

  // The row is two identical copies; sliding by half its width loops seamlessly.
  useEffect(() => {
    const track = trackRef.current;
    if (!track || reduced || typeof track.animate !== 'function') return;
    const duration = (track.scrollWidth / 2 / SPEED) * 1000;
    const anim = track.animate([{ transform: 'translateX(0)' }, { transform: 'translateX(-50%)' }], {
      duration,
      iterations: Infinity,
    });
    animation.current = anim;
    return () => {
      anim.cancel();
      animation.current = null;
    };
  }, [reduced]);

  // Hovering pauses so a quote can be read; the button pauses until pressed again.
  useEffect(() => {
    const anim = animation.current;
    if (!anim) return;
    if (paused || hovered) anim.pause();
    else anim.play();
  }, [paused, hovered, reduced]);

  return (
    <section className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-background py-14 sm:py-20">
      <div ref={revealRef} className={shown ? 'ui-stagger' : 'motion-safe:opacity-0'}>
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-6xl flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-6 px-5 sm:px-8">
          <div className="max-w-xl">
            <h2 className="font-display text-3xl font-semibold tracking-tight sm:text-5xl">Teams sleep better on Halcyon.</h2>
            <p className="mt-4 text-md text-muted-foreground sm:text-lg">
              Rated 4.9 out of 5 by more than 1,200 engineers who are on call this week.
            </p>
          </div>
          {!reduced && (
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setPaused((p) => !p)}>
              {paused ? 'Play' : 'Pause'} testimonials
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>

        {reduced ? (
          // Reduced motion: the same cards in a row people scroll themselves
          <div
            role="region"
            aria-label="Testimonials"
            tabIndex={0}
            className="mt-12 flex snap-x snap-mandatory scroll-px-5 gap-4 overflow-x-auto px-5 pb-4 outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring sm:mt-14 sm:scroll-px-8 sm:px-8"
          >
            {QUOTES.map((q) => (
              <QuoteCard key={q.name} {...q} />
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div
            className="mt-12 overflow-hidden sm:mt-14 [mask-image:linear-gradient(to_right,transparent,black_8%,black_92%,transparent)]"
            onPointerEnter={() => setHovered(true)}
            onPointerLeave={() => setHovered(false)}
          >
            <div ref={trackRef} className="flex w-max">
              <div className="flex gap-4 pr-4">
                {QUOTES.map((q) => (
                  <QuoteCard key={q.name} {...q} />
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-4 pr-4" aria-hidden="true">
                {QUOTES.map((q) => (
                  <QuoteCard key={q.name} {...q} />
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

## Shared files

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```
